name: Luna Vista by Wilawan
shortDescription: Gated estate of 19 two-storey 3- and 4-bedroom pool villas of 500 to 615 sqm in Thalang, near Nai Yang and the airport.
description:
Luna Vista by Wilawan is a gated estate of 19 villas on about 11.5 rai in Thalang, inland from Nai Yang and Nai Thon beaches and about 10 to 15 minutes from Phuket airport. It was launched in January 2025 by Wilawan Greenplace, with completion scheduled for Q4 2027.
There are two villa types. The three-bedroom Dara (about 501 sqm on a 624 sqm plot) has a 3.8 x 9 m pool with jacuzzi and a rooftop garden; the four-bedroom Luna (about 503 to 613 sqm on plots of 756 to 767 sqm) has a 4 x 10 m pool. Villas are two storeys, with EV charging points and solar power in the estate, and a furniture package is offered separately.
UWC Thailand is about 3.5 km away and Thalang Hospital about 4 km. Foreign buyers take a registered lease of up to 30 years with renewal options; the common fee is a fixed amount per villa.
